facts.value: Employers who wish to employ apprentices are required to complete an approval process.
Register your company's interest in the apprenticeship programme by completing the expression of interest form or by contacting us at apprenticeships@ul.ie.

Complete the UL Approval Process: Site visit by one of the dedicated UL programme managers to assess your suitability to host an apprenticeship. Complete the Company sponsorship paperwork, including the identification of an In-Company Mentor.

Complete the SOLAS approval process: Site visit by an Authorising Officer of the local Education & Training Board. SOLAS approval of the company for funding, including SOLAS paperwork for each apprentice.

Complete the UL Postgraduate Registration process: UL Graduate & Professional Studies will send the successful applicant the link to proceed through the normal UL postgraduate student application process.
